description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Matter state from the docket. When you are admitted to the matter and hold matter.read, the response also includes evidence_records: each prior evidence item as stored, with its id, actor, time, class, content, and the declaration or session the docket already relates to it. An actor claim stays an actor claim. This read does not make it a judgment, a law, or an established fact.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of the matter you are admitted to (returned by atlas.bind_actor). Optional when you are bound to exactly one matter.

name: atlas.get_matter
